issue.title: Bank Period Charts on period notes
issue.description: Every week, quarter, ISO-year, and all-time note shows one compact, read-only Bank Period Charts panel after its Bank Badge. The panel answers when money moved and where Out went. bob computes every cent, coverage gaps are never drawn as $0, and the panel looks like part of the stats-strip family. Daily notes, the badge, briefs, Stats, and the Mac app stay unchanged.

payload.entry: Start gate: bob-cli-lh CLOSED. Shared child partition moved to src/native/periods/children.rs (column_specs, child_specs, group_specs, dates/weeks/quarters/years_between, clip_span, period_bounds, day_caption); periods/report.rs delegates with no behavior change (all existing periods tests pass unchanged) plus golden tests for W46, W01, W53, Q4 (14 weeks), ISO 2026 (53 weeks grouped Q1-Q4), all-time across years, and caption parity. New src/native/bank/charts.rs (+charts_tests.rs): period_id_for, buckets/groups via compute_totals, states, targets, top_out, folded categories, 64-quarter->year coarsening and >64-year null; BankReport carries charts; to_json emits charts only with -c. CLI -c/--charts (alphabetical, help, example) with exit-2 refusal for -D/-m/-y/default month/-p day (JSON ok:false); human aligned bucket+group table (In green, waiting yellow, non-tracked dim, NO_COLOR respected). Tests: 22 unit tests (every invariant for W46, Q4, ISO 2026, W53, W01, all; ids/labels vs shared API; state boundaries incl IT==T; transfer/cash-account/cash-category/refund/bare-credit/zero-cent rows; pinned/one-leftover/tie/rest folding; day targets with and without headings; -s -c days []; no charts key without -c; future-only history -> buckets []; coarsen/null) and 2 CLI tests. payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: docs/reference/json-outputs.md is 3 words over the 6000-word reference budget, so bob-cli just docs-check fails lint with 'docs/reference/json-outputs.md:1: budget: over budget at 6003 words (cap 6000 for reference/)'. Reproduced on master 643b3697 (2026-11-14) by bob-cli-lm.land; first reported by bob-cli-lm.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1), which saw it identically on a clean tree. The last commit to touch the file is b3dc64a0 (SASE_BEAD bob-cli-lj.1, 'Document the charts JSON contract in docs/bank.md and json-outputs'), which added a line. Remediation: trim 3+ words from json-outputs.md, or split or move the bank report charts paragraph, then rerun just docs-check.

LAND FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (bob-cli-lj.land): lj.2 #1 Chromium hard-fail: DECLINED. It throws only when CI is set, which is the deliberate CI contract from closed bob-cli-f1. On apollo with CI unset the full npm test skips it cleanly; no defect. lj.2 #2, lj.3 #1, lj.4 #1 (perf budgets): corroborated with +1 on bob-cli-io, bob-cli-km, bob-cli-ki, bob-cli-ju; they failed in full npm test under concurrent load and passed in isolation. The bob-cli-3w stage ranker did not reproduce here and stays with its existing tracker. lj.4 #1 note-ready 'startup storm is linear' (3!=2): bisected to 2562300 (bob-cli-lm.1, bankWalk initial getMarkdownFiles scan), not this epic; bob-cli-lm.land already owns it in its remaining-work tale, so no task. lj.2 #3 shared period identity: caused by this epic, FIXED in landing (the panel now uses bankBadgePeriodIdentityValid). lj.5 #3 and DISCOVERED ISSUE #1 (json-outputs.md 6003 words): caused by lj.1's line plus a concurrent gmail edit, FIXED in landing (trimmed to 5996). lj.5 #1 (bob-cli-ku re-scope) and #2 (per-account coverage quality object): recorded as a note on snoozed bob-cli-ku; the plan's Out of scope gates both on that trial, so no new task. New: docs/reference/glossary.md generated drift from bob-cli-lm.5 (643b3697) recorded as DISCOVERED ISSUE on active epic bob-cli-lm; no task.

Verified all 5 phases against plan:202611/bank_period_charts.md and their commits: bob-cli b3dc64a0 (children.rs shared partition, charts.rs, -c CLI with exit-2 refusal, human table, 22 unit + 2 CLI tests, JSON docs) and e221958e (docs); bob-plugins d845e04 (decoder/model), d4b2bb2 (painter/styles/preview), 90f0dc9 (hosts, BANK_CACHE_SIZE 32, stats.bank_period, real-bob fixtures), 5672727 (docs). (3) Trimmed the lj.1 json-outputs.md bank line, 6003 to 5996 words, which clears the docs-check lint failure. Gates: bob-cli just check passed and just docs-check lint passed; the only docs-check failure left is glossary.md drift from bob-cli-lm.5, recorded on bob-cli-lm. bob-plugins: build:check passed, 192/192 bank tests passed, full npm test 6673/6681; the failures are 4 known load flakes (+1'd) and the startup storm bisected to bob-cli-lm.1. bob plugins sync deployed.
